name: Hoshikopi
tagline: A concept cafe with order-ahead pickup and a Stars loyalty card.
summary: The full website of an invented cafe: the menu, ordering ahead for a pickup time, Stars, events and a Bar Screen for the baristas. It is a portfolio piece, so the cafe is labelled as a concept and payments run in PayMongo test mode.

features: Order ahead: pick a size, milk and add-ons, then a 15-minute pickup window.
Pickup windows fill up, and two people can never book the last slot.
Stars loyalty: a Star for every drink, rewards to spend, and a birthday treat.
Events with seat sign-ups and an add-to-calendar file.
A Bar Screen for baristas that refreshes on its own as orders move.
Staff sign in with a second factor, and the manager gets sales reports.

build.title: The server prices everything
build.body: Money is whole centavos, never floats. The cart and checkout recompute every price, so a changed number in the browser does nothing.

build.title: One door for order status
build.body: Every status change goes through a single transition function and a table of allowed moves. Payment status only comes from verified webhooks.

build.title: Capacity under a row lock
build.body: Placing an order locks the pickup window's row in Postgres, so the last slot cannot be sold twice.

build.title: Prerendered, refreshed by tag
build.body: Public pages are static and refresh when the menu, hours or content change, using Next.js 16 Cache Components.

build.title: Tested against a real database
build.body: 193 Vitest tests run against a Postgres test database, and 194 Playwright tests drive a real browser. 14 decision records explain the choices.
